I’ll commit to 15 tons this month and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided John, Kate, and Emma each commit to the same and Luke catches zero. The clinic matters to our families, and this plan can meet its urgent need without exhausting the lake.

Let’s also all commit to no more than 6 tons each next month, then 10 each once the lake is back at 100 tons. We should share the donation receipts alongside our catch totals so everyone can see we’ve kept our word. Emma, can you commit to both the donation and the recovery limits?
